name: Glass, brass and a moving light
scope: Analytic scene fixture for this viewer; not the native RIVX3D or RIVX3S file schema.
approximations: Direct illumination and analytic visibility; no indirect path tracing
Two-interface sphere refraction, Schlick Fresnel, Beer tint; one reflected ray
Floor caustic is a shaped light-driven lobe, not a photon estimate
Portable shading is keyed over one light-position arc; material regions are separately named image meshes
